info.name: 1Factory Gets a List of Receiving Plans for Your Organization.

params.name: page
params.description: Starting page for queried rows - defaults to 0 (the start of the list). Returned rows will start at index (page * page_size).

params.name: page_size
params.description: The maximum number of records to return from the query. Defaults to 100, maximum value 500.

params.name: part_number
params.description: Part name / number to filter on.

params.name: rev
params.description: Part rev to filter on. Typically used in conjunction with the part_number query parameter.

params.name: status
params.description: Status to filter on.

params.name: version_status
params.description: Version status to filter on. Approval status is only available to Organizations with plan approvals enabled. Active is the released and highest version.

params.name: approval_status
params.description:
The status of an object that requires approval before releasing or closing.

(Availability depends on Organization settings.)

params.name: supplier
params.description: Name of supplier to filter on.

params.name: is_tablulated
params.description: If tabulated plans should be filtered on.

params.name: is_spec_lib
params.description: If spec library plans should be filtered on.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Return objects created after the specified date-time

params.name: created_before
params.description: Return objects created before the specified date-time

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Return objects updated after the specified date-time

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Return objects updated before the specified date-time

params.name: closed_after
params.description: Return only approved or rejected objects closed after the specified date-time.

params.name: closed_before
params.description: Return only approved or rejected objects closed before the specified date-time.

items.docs:
The list of receiving plans can be filtered by specifying query parameters.

Paging parameters control the number of rows Plan objects returned. By default, the first 100 plans are returned.

info.name: 1Factory Gets a Detailed Receiving Plan Record.

items.docs: Returns the specified plan record, including specifications.

info.name: 1Factory Gets a List of Receiving Inspections for Your Organization.

params.name: page
params.description: Starting page for queried rows - defaults to 0 (the start of the list). Returned rows will start at index (page * page_size).

params.name: page_size
params.description: The maximum number of records to return from the query. Defaults to 100, maximum value 500.

params.name: part_number
params.description: Part name / number to filter on.

params.name: rev
params.description: Part rev to filter on. Typically used in conjunction with the part_number query parameter.

params.name: insp_ident_1
params.description: Primary identifier to filter on for an inspection or FAI, for example a Work Order or Purchase Order. For FAIs, this is the 'FAI Number'.

params.name: insp_ident_2
params.description: Secondary identifier to filter on for an inspection or FAI, for example a Customer Purchase Order or Lot #. For FAIs this is the 'PO Number'.

params.name: supplier
params.description: Name of supplier to filter on.

params.name: project_identifier
params.description:
Name of project_identifier to filter on. Must come from your organization's Part Master Project Identifier LOV. 

(The name used in the UI for this LOV is configured in your organization's Part Master settings and might not be 'Project Identifier').

params.name: site
params.description: Location where inspection was performed. Must come from your organization's Sites List of Values.

params.name: type
params.description: Type of inspection to filter on, from your organization's Inspection Types List of Values.

params.name: insp_status
params.description: Inspection status to filter on.

params.name: review_status
params.description: Review status to filter on.

params.description: Return objects created after the specified date-time

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Return objects updated after the specified date-time

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Return objects updated before the specified date-time

params.name: closed_after
params.description: Return only approved or rejected objects closed after the specified date-time.

params.name: closed_before
params.description: Return only approved or rejected objects closed before the specified date-time.

items.docs:
The list of receiving inspections can be filtered by specifying query parameters.

Paging parameters control the number of rows Inspection objects returned. By default, the first 100 inspections are returned.

info.name: 1Factory Creates a New Receiving Inspection for Your Organization.

items.docs:
A new receiving inspection is created, ready for inspection data to be entered. 

 ## Plan Identification 
The plan used by the inspection is identified by part number and rev. An active version of a Plan for the specified part must exist when creating the inspection. 

For Inspections that are for a Plan associated with a ToS part enter the part number and rev for the ToS entry.
